description: Source code implementing hardware control and data acquisition for Bosch sensors, specifically for SMI240 accelerometer and gyroscope chips, including sensor configuration, data polling, and initialization routines.

methods.name: ap_get_sensorlist
methods.description: Retrieves the list of available sensors, initializes sensor list if not already populated.

methods.name: SMI240_convert_ODR
methods.description: Converts a desired sampling frequency to a hardware-specific ODR code.

methods.name: ap_config_phyACC
methods.description: Configures the physical accelerometer with a specified sample rate.

methods.name: ap_config_phyGYR
methods.description: Configures the physical gyroscope with a specified sample rate.

methods.name: ap_config_physensor
methods.description: Configures a physical sensor based on input ID and sample rate.

methods.name: ap_send_config
methods.description: Sends configuration to a sensor based on its list index.

methods.name: ap_send_disable_config
methods.description: Disables a sensor configuration based on its list index.

methods.name: ap_activate
methods.description: Activates or deactivates a sensor handle.

methods.name: ap_batch
methods.description: Sets batching parameters for a sensor handle.

methods.name: ap_flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor data for a given sensor handle.

methods.name: sysfs_extract_numbers
methods.description: Parses x, y, z integer values from sysfs data string.

methods.name: ap_hw_poll_smi240acc
methods.description: Polls accelerometer data from sysfs and adds to list.

methods.name: ap_hw_poll_smi240gyro
methods.description: Polls gyroscope data from sysfs and adds to list.

methods.name: IMU_hw_deliver_sensordata
methods.description: Delivers sensor data for IMU solution by polling accelerometer and gyroscope.

methods.name: ap_show_ver
methods.description: Displays version and hardware info for sensors.

methods.name: hwcntl_init
methods.description: Main initialization function for hardware control, sets function pointers and initializes sensors.
